title: Data Labeling Vendor Welfare Audit Report
description: An independently-conducted audit of a data-labelling vendor's actual wage levels, content-exposure limits, and psychological-support provision, as distinct from the vendor's contractual commitments.
evidence_description: A report from an independent auditor (not the vendor itself) documenting actual wages paid, hours worked on graphic-content review, and access to and uptake of psychological support, compared against the client's required standards.
collection_method: Independent third-party audit, including worker interviews, conducted on a recurring schedule.
artifact_format: PDF audit report; underlying interview/wage data retained as structured export where consented.

citations.title: OpenAI Used Kenyan Workers on Less Than $2 Per Hour: Exclusive
